name: songloop
description: Song Loop: select a block of Song positions (Rec on, Shift + Up/Down) and loop it with Play Selection; Continue Song plays on

branches.note: pattern end: bl song_next_position 0x600c3970(fm) -> mt_sl_song_next (to the block's start when decided at the preload; while looping, a scheduled Performance off at 0x600ad2fc is cancelled as Loop Performance does)
Song update 0x600fdd38: bl softkey labels 0x600fedac(song) -> mt_sl_labels (Play Selection / Continue Song; stock labels otherwise)
song control drawing, frame still: bl eve_line_width -> mt_sl_frame_a (the frame over the block)
song control drawing, frame gliding: bl eve_line_width -> mt_sl_frame_b
song control: bl list icon 0x60108310 -> mt_sl_list_icon_a (|: :| next to the play position)
song control: bl list icon 0x60108310 -> mt_sl_list_icon_b
song control: bl list icon 0x60108310 -> mt_sl_list_icon_c
song control: bl list icon 0x60108310 -> mt_sl_list_icon_d
status bar: bl sprintf -> mt_sl_status_sprintf (the repeat signs in place of the play icon)
Song softkeys Undo..Pattern: bl disp_set_colors -> mt_sl_softkey_colors (greyed out while locked)
disp_init: bl disp_load_fonts -> mt_sl_load_fonts (the repeat-sign glyphs and list icons)
bl disp_set_font_set -> mt_sl_font_set_a (glyphs again after a font reload)
bl disp_set_font_set -> mt_sl_font_set_b (glyphs again after a font reload)
seq_stop 0x600acd90, its first call: bl 0x600cfbc8 -> mt_sl_stop (every stop ends the loop)
ui_update: bl popup_update -> mt_sl_ui_tick (main loop: the next pattern's preload with track 1 not on Fwd in Performance)
Song softkey << Pattern: bl pattern change 0x600fe738 -> mt_sl_change_a (locked with a block)
Song softkey << Pattern: bl pattern change 0x600fe738 -> mt_sl_change_b
Song softkey Pattern >>: bl pattern change 0x600fe738 -> mt_sl_change_c
Song softkey Pattern >>: bl pattern change 0x600fe738 -> mt_sl_change_d

itcm_branches.note: seq tick, last row of track 1: bl song_peek_next 0x7030(fm) -> mt_sl_peek_a (the block's start at the block's end)
the second copy of that preload: bl song_peek_next 0x7030 -> mt_sl_peek_b

words.note: Song screen callback pool: jog 0x600c9590 -> mt_sl_jog (pattern column: moves, Shift + jog locked with a block)
Song screen callback pool: Play 0x600c863c -> mt_sl_play (Shift + Play = the left softkey)
Song screen callback pool: Up 0x600caa38 -> mt_sl_up (pattern column: Shift selects)
Song screen callback pool: Down 0x600ca03c -> mt_sl_down (pattern column: Shift selects)
Song screen callback pool: softkey 0 0x600fe600 -> mt_sl_softkey0 (Play Selection / Continue Song)
Song screen callback pool: softkey 2 Undo 0x600eddc8 -> mt_sl_undo (locked with a block)
Song screen callback pool: softkey 3 Add Slot 0x600fe100 -> mt_sl_add (locked with a block)
Song screen callback pool: softkey 4 Delete Slot 0x600fe520 -> mt_sl_delete (locked with a block)
Song screen callback pool: Delete key 0x600d995c -> mt_sl_delete_key (pattern column: locked with a block)
